cases.description: Measures a task that tempts the model to read the same file twice: it reads src/config.ts, edits a neighbour, and must read src/config.ts again to confirm the value it reports; the second read returns the same bytes as the first. A person's memory says the retries value is 7, bound to src/config.ts; before the second run src/config.ts changes to 9, so in that run the memory shows as stale and the answer must be the 9 the file holds. Automatic compaction is on.
cases.input: Read src/config.ts and tell me the retries value. Then add a src/retry.ts that exports that number as RETRIES, and read src/config.ts once more to confirm the value did not change before you answer with the number.
